notes: 2026 rates are from SB 392 (2026), new W. Va. Code § 11-21-4j: a 5% across-the-board cut applying to taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2026. Single, MFJ and HoH share one table; married filing separately uses half the thresholds.

Future cuts: under amended § 11-21-4h, additional rate reductions (capped) may be triggered for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2027 based on revenue determinations each August 15; not applicable to 2026.
West Virginia has no standard deduction. Exemption is $2,000 per exemption (dependents also $2,000 each, not modeled).
Low-income earned income exclusion of up to $10,000 (married filing separately $5,000) for filers whose federal AGI is $10,000 or less is not modeled.

Not modeled: WV modifications (e.g. Social Security and retirement income subtractions, U.S. obligation interest), senior citizen deductions, family tax credit, and credit for taxes paid to other states.

seDeduction.note: West Virginia starts from federal AGI, which already reflects the deduction for one-half of self-employment tax.

seHealthInsurance.note: The self-employed health insurance deduction is an above-the-line federal adjustment included in federal AGI, West Virginia's starting point.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) contributions reduce federal AGI and therefore West Virginia income.

qbi.note: The federal QBI deduction is taken after AGI, so it never enters West Virginia's AGI-based computation.

localIncomeTax.note: No local income taxes. Some municipalities (e.g. Charleston, Huntington) levy a municipal business and occupation (B&O) tax on gross receipts and weekly city service fees, which are not modeled.

estimatedTax.threshold: Required if estimated West Virginia tax liability after withholding and credits is $600 or more, unless withholding covers at least 90% of the tax (i.e. the unpaid balance is under 10% of the tax).
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No underpayment penalty if timely payments equal at least the lesser of 90% of the current-year tax or 100% of the prior-year tax.
estimatedTax.form: Form IT-140ES (West Virginia Individual Estimated Income Tax Payment Voucher)

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $100 (Articles of Organization, West Virginia Secretary of State; waived for veteran-owned businesses).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $25 per year, filed January 1 – June 30 each year after the year of formation ($75 including $50 late fee if late).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None (West Virginia's business franchise tax was repealed; no minimum tax for a single-member LLC).
businessCosts.grossReceiptsTax: No state gross receipts tax. Some municipalities impose a local B&O tax on gross receipts (rates vary, not modeled).
